messages:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT OPENED - Severity P1 - Single-tenant quality regression detected for tenant AcmeCorp on dedicated pool dp-12. Alert: model-quality-drop threshold breached (end-to-end eval diff +18% loss). Linked runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/model-regression

oncall-alex: Ack. paging ml-eng-jon and sre-maya. I'm joining now.

ml-eng-jon: on it. quick summary: we've started seeing coherent responses degrade into hallucinations and formatting loss for long-form prompts. Looks like outputs have higher token-level entropy after recent quant profile rollout (qprofile:v2 -> qprofile:v3) applied to dp-12 for AcmeCorp.

eng-runtime-sam: I can confirm the rollout happened 02:03 UTC (automated canary) and then 02:10 full roll for that pool. Logs show kernel path switched to q4-int8 fast-path.

sre-maya: Customer (AcmeCorp) flagged an ongoing regression at 02:25 UTC via support channel. They're seeing legal language hallucinations in generated contracts. This is customer-impacting.

oncall-alex: Triage goals: 1) mitigate customer impact asap (restore previous quality), 2) avoid broad regressions to other tenants, 3) safe rollback path + postmortem.

ml-eng-jon: Short mitigation options: A) Revert quant profile to qprofile:v2 for tenant AcmeCorp only (recommended), B) Route AcmeCorp to float model variant (redwood-llm-1.0-float32) in that pool, C) Increase decode temperature clamp as temporary band-aid (risky).

eng-runtime-sam: Revert plan for tenant-scoped profile change is supported. CLI to pin tenant to old profile: ```redwoodctl tenant update --tenant acmecorp --pool dp-12 --quant-profile qprofile:v2 --reason "emergency revert due to quality regression"``` This will only affect routing for that tenant. Propagation TTL ~15s.

sre-maya: I'm going to prepare a fallback route in case revert fails. Route command: ```redwoodctl routing set --tenant acmecorp --model redwood-llm-1.0-float32 --pool dp-12 --priority 100``` That keeps traffic inside dp-12 (no cross-region).

oncall-alex: I'll notify support to tell the customer we're applying an emergency revert and expect ~1-2 min interruption. @prod-support-rita please update ticket ACME-9876 with the plan.

prod-support-rita: Updating ticket ACME-9876: "Engineering applying tenant-scoped quant revert; expected brief degraded responses for ~2 minutes, will confirm when stable." Also asking customer for sample prompt that demonstrates regression.

ml-eng-jon: Running the revert now. Executing: ```redwoodctl tenant update --tenant acmecorp --pool dp-12 --quant-profile qprofile:v2 --reason "emergency revert" --dry-run false```

eng-runtime-sam: I see the control plane accepted the update. Pushing to runtime controllers... 10% -> 50% -> 100% for tenant routing.

sre-maya: Observe logs: model instances for AcmeCorp now serving via qprofile:v2 kernel path. Monitoring evals (canary prompt set) for quality delta.

ml-eng-jon: Canary evals showing improvement: quality metric back within baseline (diff +1.2%). Sending notification to oncall.

prod-support-rita: Customer support says they're seeing improved output now, requests follow-up audit. ACME-9876 updated.

oncall-alex: Great. Next: retain debug traces for 24h, capture model versions, quant profile diffs, and kernel selection logs. Create postmortem ticket PMT-4432. Must include decision to revert the profile and timeline.

ml-eng-jon: Action items assigned: - jon: generate eval diffs and seed list for postmortem - sam: collect kernel and runtime logs for dp-12 between 01:50-02:40 UTC - maya: run config audit to ensure qprofile:v3 didn't leak to other tenants - rita: confirm customer is satisfied and record mitigation comms

eng-runtime-sam: One more: toggling tenant pin is reversible. If we need to reintroduce qprofile:v3 after fixes, we'll do a phased canary with a stricter prompt-set and monitor slower. Command to reapply: ```redwoodctl tenant update --tenant acmecorp --pool dp-12 --quant-profile qprofile:v3 --canary 5%```

sre-maya: Handing ongoing ownership to ml-eng-jon for root cause and to oncall for monitoring. I'm moving to watch-only and will be on-call for the next hour if anything flips.

oncall-alex: Handoff: I'm signing off, maya taking on-call lead. Thanks everyone.

ml-eng-jon: I'll dig into why qprofile:v3 caused regression — likely a distribution shift with long-form tokenization + KV cache interplay. Will include small reproducer.

prod-support-rita: Customer confirmation: "We're seeing results back to expected. Thanks for the quick rollback." Marking ticket as mitigated.

inc-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE - Severity downgraded to P3 - Mitigation applied and verified at 02:45 UTC. Postmortem required.

ml-eng-jon: Final: creating PMT-4432 with timeline and remediation plan: 1) revert stands; 2) freeze qprofile:v3 rollout until deeper evals; 3) add tenant-scoped canary rules for quant profiles; 4) add automated evals with customer prompt-sets for enterprise pools.

prod-support-rita: I'll follow up with AcmeCorp for a formal RCA attestation and schedule a 1:1.

oncall-alex: Closing thread for now. If anything new pops, reopen. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
